info.title: EventHub OS API
info.description: Control-plane API. Permission catalog version 1. Organization IDs in paths are locators only; access is resolved from the caller's membership.

post.summary: Register with email and password. Always answers 202 to prevent account enumeration.
post.x-eventhub-idempotency-exempt: Keyed by email: repeating it cannot create a second account; it only replaces an unverified password and re-sends verification.

401.description: Unauthenticated, or invalid credentials on login

404.description: Not found (also returned for resources in other organizations)

422.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different payload

500.description: Internal error (generic body with correlation ID)

post.summary: Exchange email and password for a bearer session token, or for a two-step verification challenge when the account has MFA on (ADR-0022).
post.x-eventhub-idempotency-exempt: Each call issues a fresh session; storing issued tokens for replay would persist secrets.
